Beef and pork meatloaf with a sweet tomato glaze, creamy mash, onion gravy and buttered peas. Heat the oven to 180°C. Mix the mince, onion, egg and breadcrumbs, press into a loaf tin and spread with the tomato sauce mixed with sugar. Bake until cooked through, then rest. Boil the potatoes and mash with half the butter and the milk. Stir the flour into the loaf tin juices with the stock and simmer for gravy. Cook the peas and serve.

dishes.make_ahead: Mix the dry batter ingredients up to 1 week ahead; add the egg and buttermilk and fry on the night

steps.text: Whisk the polenta, flour, baking powder, sugar and salt, then whisk in the egg and buttermilk to a thick batter. Pour into a tall glass.
Heat the oil to 175C in a deep pot.
Pat the frankfurts dry and push a skewer into each.
Dip each frankfurt into the batter, twirl to coat and fry 2 at a time, turning, until deep golden. Drain.
Serve hot with mustard and tomato sauce.

dishes.make_ahead: Make the buttermilk dressing up to 2 days ahead; crumb and fry the tomatoes on the night

steps.text: Slice the tomatoes 1cm thick, salt lightly and sit on paper towel.
Set out the flour, the eggs beaten with 60ml of the buttermilk, and the polenta mixed with the cayenne.
Dip each slice in flour, egg and polenta.
Shallow-fry in the oil for 2 to 3 minutes a side until golden, and drain.
Stir the rest of the buttermilk with the mayonnaise, chives, hot sauce and pepper and serve with the tomatoes.

dishes.n: Beale Street dry rub pork ribs with slaw
dishes.make_ahead: Rub the ribs up to 1 day ahead and keep them in the fridge; bake on the day and toss the slaw while they finish

ingredients.item: apple cider vinegar, for the mop

steps.text: Mix the paprikas, brown sugar, garlic powder, onion powder, cayenne, thyme, salt and pepper and rub all over the ribs, keeping 1 tbsp back.
Leave the ribs in the fridge to take in the rub.
Wrap the ribs tightly in foil on a tray and bake at 150C.
Unwrap, turn the oven to 220C, splash with the mop vinegar, dust with the last of the rub and roast until crusted.
Toss the cabbages and carrot with the mayonnaise, the rest of the vinegar and the sugar.
Cut the ribs and serve with the slaw and slices of white bread.

veg.n: Beale Street dry rub cauliflower with slaw
veg.make_ahead: Mix the dry rub up to 1 month ahead and the slaw dressing up to 2 days ahead; roast and toss the slaw on the night

ingredients.item: apple cider vinegar, for the mop

steps.text: Heat the oven to 220C. Cut the cauliflowers into thick wedges through the stalk.
Mix the paprikas, brown sugar, garlic powder, onion powder, cayenne, thyme, salt and pepper, toss the wedges with the oil and coat them well in the rub.
Roast on a lined tray for 35 minutes, turning once, until charred at the edges and soft at the stalk.
Splash the wedges with the vinegar mopping sauce and roast 5 minutes more.
Toss the cabbages and carrot with the mayonnaise, the rest of the vinegar and the sugar.
Serve the cauliflower with the slaw and slices of white bread.

veg.n: Graceland lentil loaf with mash and gravy
veg.make_ahead: Shape the meatloaf up to 1 day ahead; bake on the night

steps.text: Heat the oven to 180°C. Fry the mushrooms and onion until dry, then mix with the mashed lentils, egg, breadcrumbs and cheddar and press into a loaf tin. Spread with the tomato sauce mixed with sugar.
Bake until firm, then rest.
Boil the potatoes and mash with half the butter and the milk.
Melt the rest of the butter, stir in the flour and stock and simmer for gravy. Cook the peas and serve.

dishes.n: Graceland fried peanut butter and banana sandwiches
dishes.make_ahead: Best fried just before serving; mash the bananas no more than 1 hour ahead with a squeeze of lemon

steps.text: Mash the bananas.
Spread the bread with peanut butter, spread banana over 4 slices and sandwich together.
Fry 2 at a time in half the butter over medium heat, pressing, until deep golden on both sides. Repeat with the rest of the butter.
Cut into fingers, drizzle with honey and dust with icing sugar.

dishes.make_ahead: Brew and chill the sweet tea up to 2 days ahead and keep it in a jug in the fridge; pour over ice to order

ingredients.item: ripe peaches, 2 sliced for syrup, 1 for serving

steps.text: Simmer 2 of the peaches with the sugar and 250ml water, then mash and strain.
Pour 1 litre boiling water over the tea bags, steep 5 minutes and remove.
Stir in the peach syrup, lemon juice and 500ml cold water and chill.
Pour over ice with slices of the last peach and the mint.

s.note: Frankfurts on sticks in a sweet polenta and buttermilk batter, fried golden, with American mustard and tomato sauce
s.how: Whisk 150g fine polenta, 150g plain flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 2 tbsp sugar and 1 tsp salt, then whisk in 1 egg and 250ml buttermilk to a thick batter and pour into a tall glass. Heat 1.5 litres oil to 175C in a deep pot. Pat 8 frankfurts dry and push a bamboo skewer into each. Dip in the batter, twirl to coat and fry 2 at a time for 3 to 4 minutes, turning, until deep golden. Drain and serve hot with mustard and tomato sauce.

s.note: Thick slices of green tomato in a crisp polenta and flour crust, fried golden, with a spicy buttermilk and chive dressing
s.how: Slice 4 large green tomatoes 1cm thick, salt lightly and sit on paper towel for 15 minutes. Set out a bowl of 75g flour, a bowl of 2 eggs beaten with 60ml buttermilk and a bowl of 100g fine polenta mixed with 1/2 tsp cayenne and 1/2 tsp salt. Dip each slice in flour, egg and polenta. Shallow-fry in 1cm of oil for 2 to 3 minutes a side until golden and drain. Stir 125ml buttermilk with 3 tbsp mayonnaise, chopped chives, a dash of hot sauce and pepper and serve with the hot tomatoes.

m.n: Beale Street dry rub pork ribs with slaw
m.note: Pork ribs in a smoky paprika, brown sugar and garlic dry rub, slow-baked and mopped with vinegar, with creamy slaw and white bread
m.how: Mix 2 tbsp sweet paprika, 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 2 tsp each garlic and onion powder, 1 tsp each cayenne, thyme and pepper and 2 tsp salt. Rub all over 2kg American-style pork ribs and leave 1 hour in the fridge. Wrap tightly in foil on a tray and bake at 150C for 2 1/2 hours. Unwrap, turn the oven to 220C, splash with 60ml cider vinegar, dust with a little more rub and roast 15 minutes until crusted. Toss shredded green and red cabbage and 2 grated carrots with 100g mayonnaise, 2 tbsp cider vinegar and 1 tsp sugar. Cut the ribs and serve with the slaw and white bread.

w.n: Graceland fried peanut butter and banana sandwiches
w.note: Peanut butter and mashed ripe banana in white bread, fried golden in butter, with a drizzle of honey and a dusting of icing sugar
w.how: Mash 3 ripe bananas. Spread 8 slices of white bread with 160g smooth peanut butter and spread the banana over 4 of them, then sandwich together. Melt 40g butter in a large frying pan over medium heat and fry the sandwiches 2 at a time for 3 minutes a side, pressing with a spatula, until deep golden, adding more butter for the second batch. Cut into fingers, drizzle with honey and dust with icing sugar.

d.note: Strong black tea sweetened while hot, chilled with fresh peach syrup and lemon, poured over ice with mint
d.how: Simmer 2 sliced ripe peaches with 120g sugar and 250ml water for 8 minutes, then mash and strain. Pour 1 litre boiling water over 6 black tea bags, steep 5 minutes and remove. Stir in the peach syrup and the juice of 1 lemon, add 500ml cold water and chill for at least 2 hours. Pour over ice with peach slices, lemon and mint.
